author: Thomas à Kempis
title: That we must rest in God above all goods and gifts

verses.text: Above all things and in all things thou shalt rest alway in the Lord, O my soul, for he himself is the eternal rest of the saints.
verses.modernizedText: Above all things and in all things you shall always rest in the Lord, O my soul, for He Himself is the eternal rest of the saints.

verses.text: Grant me, most sweet and loving Jesus, to rest in Thee above every creature, above all health and beauty, above all glory and honour, above all power and dignity, above all knowledge and skilfulness, above all riches and arts, above all joy and exultation, above all fame and praise, above all sweetness and consolation, above all hope and promise, above all merit and desire, above all gifts and rewards which Thou canst give and pour forth, above all joy and jubilation which the mind is able to receive and feel; in a word, above Angels and Archangels and all the army of heaven, above all things visible and invisible, and above everything which Thou, O my God, art not.
verses.modernizedText: Grant me, most sweet and loving Jesus, to rest in You above every creature, above all health and beauty, above all glory and honor, above all power and dignity, above all knowledge and skill, above all riches and arts, above all joy and exultation, above all fame and praise, above all sweetness and consolation, above all hope and promise, above all merit and desire, above all gifts and rewards which You can give and pour forth, above all joy and jubilation which the mind is able to receive and feel; in a word, above Angels and Archangels and all the army of heaven, above all things visible and invisible, and above everything which You, O my God, are not.

verses.text: For Thou, O Lord, my God, art best above all things; Thou only art the Most High, Thou only the Almighty, Thou only the All-sufficient, and the Fulness of all things; Thou only the All-delightsome and the All-comforting; Thou alone the altogether lovely and altogether loving; Thou alone the Most Exalted and Most Glorious above all things; in Whom all things are, and were, and ever shall be, altogether and all-perfect.
verses.modernizedText: For You, O Lord, my God, are best above all things; You alone are the Most High, You alone the Almighty, You alone the All-sufficient, and the Fullness of all things; You alone the All-delightsome and the All-comforting; You alone the altogether lovely and altogether loving; You alone the Most Exalted and Most Glorious above all things; in whom all things are, and were, and ever shall be, altogether and all-perfect.

verses.text: And thus it falleth short and is insufficient whatsoever Thou givest to me without Thyself or whatsoever Thou revealest or dost promise concerning Thyself, whilst Thou art not seen or fully possessed: since verily my heart cannot truly rest nor be entirely content, except it rest in Thee, and go beyond all gifts and every creature.
verses.modernizedText: And thus whatever You give to me without Yourself, or whatever You reveal or promise concerning Yourself, falls short and is insufficient while You are not seen or fully possessed: since truly my heart cannot truly rest or be entirely content, unless it rests in You, and goes beyond all gifts and every creature.

verses.text: O my most beloved Spouse, Jesus Christ, most holy lover of my soul, Ruler of this whole Creation, who shall give me the wings of true liberty, that I may flee to Thee and find rest?
verses.modernizedText: O my most beloved Spouse, Jesus Christ, most holy lover of my soul, Ruler of this whole Creation, who will give me the wings of true liberty, that I may flee to You and find rest?

verses.text: Oh when shall it be given me to be open to receive Thee to the full, and to see how sweet Thou art, O Lord my God?
verses.modernizedText: Oh when will it be given me to be open to receive You to the full, and to see how sweet You are, O Lord my God?

verses.text: When shall I collect myself altogether in Thee, that because of Thy love I may not feel myself at all, but may know Thee only above every sense and measure, in measure not known to others.
verses.modernizedText: When shall I gather myself altogether in You, that because of Your love I may not feel myself at all, but may know You only above every sense and measure, in a measure not known to others?

verses.text: But now I ofttimes groan, and bear my sad estate with sorrow; because many evils befall me in this vale of miseries which continually disturb and fill me with sorrow, and encloud me, continually hinder and fill me with care, allure and entangle me, that I cannot have free access to Thee, nor enjoy that sweet intercourse which is always near at hand to the blessed spirits.
verses.modernizedText: But now I often groan, and bear my sad condition with sorrow; because many evils befall me in this vale of miseries which continually disturb and fill me with sorrow, and cloud me, continually hinder and fill me with care, allure and entangle me, so that I cannot have free access to You, or enjoy that sweet intercourse which is always near at hand to the blessed spirits.

verses.text: Let my deep sighing come before Thee, and my manifold desolation on the earth.
verses.modernizedText: Let my deep sighing come before You, and my manifold desolation on the earth.

verses.text: O Jesus, Light of Eternal Glory, solace of the wandering soul, before Thee my mouth is without speech, and my silence speaketh to Thee.
verses.modernizedText: O Jesus, Light of Eternal Glory, solace of the wandering soul, before You my mouth is without speech, and my silence speaks to You.

verses.text: How long will my Lord delay to come unto me?
verses.modernizedText: How long will my Lord delay to come to me?

verses.text: Let Him come unto me, His poor and humble one, and make me glad.
verses.modernizedText: Let Him come to me, His poor and humble one, and make me glad.

verses.text: Let Him put forth His hand, and deliver His holy one from every snare.
verses.modernizedText: Let Him put forth His hand, and deliver His holy one from every snare.

verses.text: Come, Oh come; for without Thee shall be no joyful day or hour, for Thou art my joy, and without Thee is my table empty.
verses.modernizedText: Come, oh come; for without You there will be no joyful day or hour, for You are my joy, and without You my table is empty.

verses.text: I am miserable, and in a manner imprisoned and loaded with fetters, until Thou refresh me by the light of Thy presence, and give me liberty, and show Thy loving countenance.
verses.modernizedText: I am miserable, and in a manner imprisoned and loaded with fetters, until You refresh me by the light of Your presence, and give me liberty, and show Your loving countenance.

verses.text: Let others seek some other thing instead of Thee, whatsoever it shall please them; but for my part nothing else pleaseth or shall please, save Thou, my God, my hope, my eternal salvation.
verses.modernizedText: Let others seek some other thing instead of You, whatever pleases them; but for my part nothing else pleases or will please, except You, my God, my hope, my eternal salvation.

verses.text: I will not hold my peace, nor cease to implore, until Thy grace return, and until Thou speak to me within.
verses.modernizedText: I will not be silent, or cease to implore, until Your grace returns, and until You speak to me within.

verses.text: “Behold, here I am!
verses.modernizedText: “Behold, here I am!

verses.text: Behold, I come to thee, for thou didst call Me.
verses.modernizedText: Behold, I come to you, for you called Me.

verses.text: Thy tears and the longing of thy soul, thy humbleness and contrition of heart have inclined Me, and brought Me to thee.”
verses.modernizedText: Your tears and the longing of your soul, your humbleness and contrition of heart have inclined Me, and brought Me to you.”

verses.text: And I said Lord, I have called upon Thee, and I have longed to enjoy Thee, being ready to reject everything for Thy sake.
verses.modernizedText: And I said, Lord, I have called upon You, and I have longed to enjoy You, being ready to reject everything for Your sake.

verses.text: For Thou didst first move me to seek Thee.
verses.modernizedText: For You first moved me to seek You.

verses.text: Therefore, blessed be Thou, O Lord, who has wrought this good work upon Thy servant, according to the multitude of Thy mercy.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore, blessed are You, O Lord, who have wrought this good work upon Your servant, according to the multitude of Your mercy.

verses.text: What then hath Thy servant to say in Thy presence, save to humble himself greatly before Thee, being alway mindful of his own iniquity and vileness.
verses.modernizedText: What then has Your servant to say in Your presence, except to humble himself greatly before You, being always mindful of his own iniquity and vileness?

verses.text: For there is none like unto Thee in all marvels of heaven and earth.
verses.modernizedText: For there is none like You in all the marvels of heaven and earth.

verses.text: Excellent are Thy works, true are Thy judgments, and by Thy Providence are all things governed.
verses.modernizedText: Excellent are Your works, true are Your judgments, and by Your Providence all things are governed.

verses.text: Therefore praise and glory be unto Thee, O Wisdom of the Father, let my mouth and my soul and all created things praise and bless Thee together.
verses.modernizedText: Therefore praise and glory be to You, O Wisdom of the Father; let my mouth and my soul and all created things praise and bless You together.
